subject: Discrepancy on invoice VEN026-0021
body:
Dear Lotus Industries Pvt Ltd team,

We are reconciling purchases with GSTR-2B and found a mismatch for invoice VEN026-0021 dated 6 Sep 2025. The Supplier’s GSTR-2B line shows tax Rs 4,769 while the invoice shows Rs 4,185. Consequently Rs 584 of input tax credit is affected. Please amend your return or correct the booking and confirm once done.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
